verdicts.reason: A breaks the whole structure. The TUE row is cut off from the list and pushed to the top-left. The headline is shoved into the top-right corner. 'All free, all at 19:00.' sits between WED and THU, so the schedule reads out of order. The logo is huge and in the wrong place, and the gaps are random. B keeps the original reading order and the logo-then-headline-then-list structure. But it is a stretched copy of the banner: everything is small in a mostly empty square. The subline floats far below the headline, the divider lines have lost their rows, the 'GALLERY' text under the logo is tiny, and the three talks are spaced far apart.
